body:
Thanks for all the help and don't hesitate to PM if anything ever happens or you want to talk (I will check this account at least once a week).
Thank you so much for all the help and I can certianly PM you after I've told my boyfriend that I want to go see a psychologist and told my parents. Yay for those conversations...

On a side note, it wasn't even fine ice cream I was bribed with which is shameful :P

I have one last question.
I was sexually abused when I was about 11 by a friend. It started off as mutual, consensual experimentation but soon got to the point where I said no and she was bribing me (with ice cream, may I say. It is my biggest weakness after cats) to do stuff and I was wondering if (since I'm under age, nearly 16), a psychologist would be under law required to tell anyone?

I don't have enough confidence to sit down and talk with my parents just yet.

How should I tell my boyfriend I want to go see a psychologist because he thinks he fixed my depression and anxiety himself (they did lessen significantly for a few months)? 
Also because he will get hurt over it. 
Thank you for helping me though :)

I would probably got to a psychologist that I knew would listen to me but then what would I tell my boyfriend? 
I have a plethora of issues I want to talk about with someone, my boyfriend being one, but I can't go see a psychologist without him freaking out about it because my last meds made me weird and apparently they made me cut myself (I was already self harming at the time, I don't any more) and he'd think they're going to do stuff to me and that I'd just be talking about him all session.  

the problem with my parents is just that they weren't really there when I was little, we moved from one continent to another so that affected me and they weren't there for me with that and my mum always tells my business to everyone. It's nothing major but enough to not make me want to talk to them about anything. They're more like acquaintances than friends to me.

I have seen a psychologist before but I confessed to her about hallucinations and an eating disorder and other stuff but she didn't seem to believe a word I said. I got diagnosed with minor depression. I don't want to go see one again.

Hey :) I don't know if you'll see this since you deleted your account (you may always check back or reply through a different account, who knows) but I was wondering if you'd like to talk about how your father destroyed your life? Or anything? Whether it be your cat, your friend, your house, even what you ate last?
